title.value: EU launches coastal restoration call for regional pilot teams

field_teaser.value: Regional teams can now apply for a new EU-backed coastal restoration call focused on measurable pilot actions and reusable data.

body.value:
The European Commission has opened a new call for regional pilot teams working on coastal restoration and shoreline resilience.

The programme will support small-scale actions that combine community participation, practical restoration work, and evidence gathering for future policy decisions.

Selected projects will publish their methods and findings in a reusable format so local administrations and partner organisations can compare outcomes across different coastal contexts.
